# 2 Baruch Chapter 51 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** When the day of judgment arrives — after all I have told you comes to pass — the forms of those found guilty will become even more terrible than they are now,

**2** for they will suffer torment. But the glory of those who have now been justified by my law, who lived with understanding, who planted wisdom as a root in their hearts —

**3** their splendor will be transformed and glorified. Their faces will be illuminated with the light of their own beauty, so that they may enter and possess the world that does not die.

**4** Then those who rejected my law will lament — those who shut their ears to wisdom and refused to receive understanding.

**5** "When they see those they once looked down on now exalted and glorified beyond them, a transformation will occur: the righteous will shine like angels, while the wicked will be further consumed with dread at what they behold.

**6** For the wicked will see the vision first — and then be led away to torment.

**7** "But those who have been saved by their deeds, for whom the law was their hope, understanding their expectation, and wisdom their confidence —

**8** will wonders appear to them in their time? Yes — the world to come will be given to them, and the age of the blessed will arrive.

**9** "For the world that does not pass away will come; the blessing prepared for those who were never captured will be fulfilled; and those who were taken captive will be set free.

**10** At that time the resting places will be unlocked, the treasury of souls given back; the hours of night will not be counted anymore, nor will the hours of day.

**11** "Those who have been saved will face no more hardship. That world will be free from every adversity.

**12** When a free person walks out, they do not return to prison. When the blessed go forth, they will never look on sorrow again.

**13** "They will see the world that is now invisible to them, and they will experience a time now hidden from them.

**14** Time will no longer make them old. They will live in the heights of that world, made like the angels, equal to the stars.

**15** They will be able to take any form they wish — from beauty to lovelier beauty, from light to the splendor of glory.

**16** The vast spaces of Paradise will be opened before them; they will behold the beauty of the majesty of the living creatures beneath the throne, and all the angelic hosts — who are now restrained by my word, prevented from appearing, held by my command to remain in their places until their time comes."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
